title: Step-0 Peer Declaration
description: Canonical, versioned schema for the declaration_<game_id>.json artifact (protocol_contract.md section 5). Frozen for cross-repository compatibility during session recovery step C, resolving risk #14. This file is a deliberately shared, byte-identical reference document -- like the shared binding game.json -- kept in both police_peer and thief_peer; it is not production source code and is not imported by either peer's production code.

schema_version.description: Frozen canonical schema version. Bumped from declaration/1 during session recovery step C.

game_uid.description: Appendix-F-derived stable UUID string, protocol_contract.md section 3.1.

police_repository.description: The Police repository URL. An explicit unresolved-local-development placeholder value is acceptable (e.g. a github.com URL for a repo not yet created/pushed) but the field itself must never be fabricated -- it must be exactly what the peer's own private configuration declares.

thief_repository.description: The Thief repository URL. Same placeholder-acceptable rule as police_repository.

police_mcp_url.description: Police's local MCP endpoint URL (127.0.0.1 only outside a manual-gate-approved public tunnel).

thief_mcp_url.description: Thief's local MCP endpoint URL (127.0.0.1 only outside a manual-gate-approved public tunnel).

num_sub_games.description: The number of sub-games in the series this declaration covers (6 for the binding league series; 1 only in the explicitly-named smoke fixture).

shared_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw, byte-identical shared game.json both peers hold.

git_commit.description: This peer's own local git HEAD commit hash for this game (may change game-to-game; App.E rule 53).

gpu_available.description: Explicit availability flag -- never inferred solely from gpu_model being null.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of every OTHER field in this document -- a documented commitment representation, recomputable and comparable by the replay verifier. Not a substitute for the separate nonce-based Step-0 commit/reveal exchange (domain/declaration.py::seal_declaration), which remains unchanged.
